# What goes in a column

So far a new column has been arithmetic on the ones already there. This part is
about everything else you can put in one.

Text you need to clean up. A number that arrived as text. A date you want the
year out of. A category that depends on a condition. A value that is missing,
which is its own subject and gets a chapter.

Every one of these is written the same way, inside `add` or `summarize`, so
there is no new grammar in this part. There are only more words to write in a
place you already know.
